cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(scan_line_updates LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Quick Test)
add_executable(scan_line_updates probe.cpp ../../../app/src/scan_lines.cpp ../../../app/src/scan_lines.hpp)
target_include_directories(scan_line_updates PRIVATE ../../../app/src)
target_link_libraries(scan_line_updates PRIVATE Qt6::Quick Qt6::Test)
